band.unit: NZD per m2 of building floor area (GST exclusive)
band.basis: Working estimate (not a certified price). Main item = excavation-and-replacement ground improvement priced from QV CostBuilder Canterbury TC guidance rows (unreviewed): $218.8/m2 shallow (1 m) to $420/m2 deep replacement (subtotal row t13:r14). Add minor allowances: verification testing/monitoring $11-42/m2, set-out/access/sundries $7-29/m2. Total $237-491/m2, midpoint ~$360/m2. Low confidence because: (1) the ground-improvement method and treatment depth are not decided (1 m vs 2 m+ drives most of the spread); (2) QV rates derive from residential MBIE TC guidance and are a proxy for light commercial; (3) 'how common' is answered at citywide/qualitative level only - the site-specific likelihood needs the geotechnical report and CCC liquefaction/TC mapping. Assumption priced: single-storey, footprint = floor area, full-footprint treatment, construction-only (design and investigation excluded).

band.unit: NZ$ per m2 of building floor area (GST exclusive)
band.basis: Christchurch, GST exclusive, $/m2 of floor area. Low = QV TC1/TC2 'excavate and replace upper layers of soil with compacted gravels + geogrid' earthworks at nominal 1.0 m depth ($80 excavate/dispose + $126 GAP65 hardfill + $12.8 geogrid = $218.8/m2) + low QA allowance $8 = $226.8/m2. High = same base + deeper TC3 imported-GAP40 build-up uplift $201.2 + high QA allowance $25 = $445/m2. Centre $336/m2 is the midpoint. Built by ADDING distinct components; the concrete floor slab ($213/m2 in the same QV build-ups) and all building foundation/structural work are EXCLUDED per the pinned scope, as are geotechnical investigation and design. Method assumption: excavate-and-replace with hardfill + geogrid (the standard published NZ ground-improvement approach for liquefaction-prone ground and the only method carried in QV CostBuilder); treatment depth 1.0 m (low) to ~3 m (high). Rate is per m2 of building floor area, so it is sensitive to the ratio of treated area (usually footprint + a perimeter margin) to floor area on multi-storey or partly-paved sites; for a single-storey building treated area ≈ floor area. Confidential band, not a certified price.

band.unit: NZD per m2 of building floor area (GST exclusive)
band.basis: Excavate-and-replace (geogrid-reinforced gravel raft) ground improvement — the standard Christchurch/MBIE liquefaction mitigation for lightly loaded buildings. Low end = shallow ~1 m soil replacement (QV MBIE TC1/TC2 detail: excavate/dispose $80 + GAP65 hardfill $126 + triaxial geogrid $12.80 = $218.80/m2) plus minor allowance $5. High end = deep ~3 m imported GAP40 replacement with 2 geogrid layers (QV MBIE TC3 Type 1 build-up total $420/m2) plus minor allowance $25. Mid ~$330/m2. Excludes building foundations and floor slab (QV slab $213/m2 not added), geotechnical investigation and design, repairs, and (assumed) construction testing/monitoring. Rates are all-in per m2 of floor area from unreviewed QV CostBuilder rows, Christchurch. Method and treatment depth are undecided, which drives the ~2x spread and the low confidence; if the method/depth is fixed, confidence rises. Stone columns/vibro-replacement, compaction grouting, dynamic/rapid-impact compaction and deep soil mixing are not priced in QV — obtain contractor quotes if specified.
